blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Scope the lookup to the caller's organization, as the list route does: read `currentUser(req)` and query `WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2` with `[id, user.orgId]`, answering 404 when no row matches (so another organization's ids are not confirmed). Add a test where a user of org 7 asks for an invoice of org 8 and gets 404. Insecure direct object reference, CWE-639 / CWE-862: any signed-in user of the accounting app sends `GET /invoices/1`, `/invoices/2`, … and reads every other organization's invoice numbers and totals.
findings.title: GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice

findings.recommendation: Keep the details in the server log (`console.error(err)` already does) and answer a generic body such as `{ error: "internal error" }`. Any caller who triggers a failure — e.g. a database error raised by `query` in an invoices route — receives the stack trace (file paths, module layout, dependency versions) and the raw `pg` error message, which can carry SQL fragments, table and column names or connection details. CWE-209.
findings.title: Error handler sends the error message and stack trace to the client
